title: Zimbabwe's Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0) Country Statement, 2025-2035
organization: Government of Zimbabwe, Ministry of Environment, Climate and Wildlife
geographic_coverage: communities dependent on climate-sensitive natural resources
temporal_coverage: Reported drought seasons from 2012 to 2024 and climate-hazard outlook, in a 2025 NDC
methodology: NDC summarizes national hazard trends and adaptation priorities drawn from the NAP.
limitations: Hazard section provides no district-level event-loss counts or event attribution.

title: Zimbabwe Economic Update: Improving Resilience to Weather Shocks and Climate Change
temporal_coverage: National agriculture profile and 2023-2024 El Nino drought impacts, reported in January 2025
methodology: World Bank update summary reports sector exposure and agricultural and macroeconomic effects of the El Nino drought.
limitations: Press page summarizes the update; calculation methods and subnational outcomes are not shown.

title: Zimbabwe Drought Flash Appeal: May 2024–April 2025
organization: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs and UN Resident/Humanitarian Coordinator for Zimbabwe
temporal_coverage: El Niño drought conditions through May 2024 and the humanitarian appeal period May 2024–April 2025.
methodology: UN inter-agency appeal drawing on the government crop assessment, ZimVAC and sector-cluster analyses.
limitations: Appeal-era estimates and risk analysis; protection links are not incident-level causal evaluations.

title: Humanitarian Action for Children Factsheet, 2025 Projection: Zimbabwe
temporal_coverage: 2024 drought, nutrition and water-source data with a UNICEF appeal outlook for the now-expired 2025 response period.
methodology: UNICEF appeal using ZimVAC, health-surveillance and water-point data plus a named field account.
limitations: 2025 targets expired; claims use dated 2024 conditions and one illustrative case.

title: Chizivano Shava: Innovating Water Harvesting and Climate-Smart Agriculture in Mwenezi
temporal_coverage: Climate Resilient Livelihoods project practices and reported outputs through 2024, described in March 2025.
methodology: UNDP project feature using a named lead farmer and extension officer account and reported project outputs.
limitations: Project feature and individual testimony, not a representative household survey or independent impact evaluation.

title: GCF Secretariat Witnesses Climate Investment in Action Across Zimbabwe
organization: United Nations Development Programme Zimbabwe, reporting a Green Climate Fund Secretariat field mission
temporal_coverage: GCF/UNDP field visit in August 2026 and project results reported in September 2026.
methodology: UNDP narrative of a GCF Secretariat field mission, project outputs, officials and farmer accounts.
limitations: Implementer and mission reporting; results are not independently evaluated and participant accounts are illustrative.

title: Towads a common vision of climate, peace and security in Zimbabwe
organization: Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT, CGIAR Climate Security team, SAPPC and ACCORD
temporal_coverage: A two-day stakeholder workshop and report published in 2024; publisher page summarizes the report's shared vision.
methodology: Official publication-page summary of a two-day multi-stakeholder climate, peace and security workshop convened in Harare.
limitations: Only the publisher-page excerpt was accessible; pathways reflect workshop synthesis, not tested causal findings or named local cases.
